verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs claim fine-grained reactive state updates via Signals. Community users describe explicit component data flow through @Input/@Output and a readable [attribute]/(event) binding syntax, which separates inbound data from outbound events. However, the evidence never documents tracing or debugging state changes, and never says how Angular handles or avoids implicit two-way binding. missing for 10: documentation of unidirectional data-flow guarantees, state-change tracing/debugging tooling, explicit treatment of two-way binding versus one-way flow, independent hands-on corroboration for modern Signals-based flow
